Parameters: 
image (Image *): Pointer to the image structure to which DDS info is written.
pixelFormat (size_t): Format of the pixel data.

Returns:

Logic: 
The function initializes various flags and capabilities for the DDS header based on the provided parameters. It writes the DDS magic number, header size, and image dimensions to the blob. Depending on the compression type, it calculates and writes the appropriate size for the image data. The function also handles different pixel formats, including those with alpha channels, and writes the necessary color masks and caps information.
